Wide Bevel (Shaping Tools)

Summary

Cuts a wide slanted edge along the rim of each input widget.

Parameters

arcpy.2d.Bevel2(in_widgets, out_widgets, {width})

in_widgets The widgets to bevel. Widget Layer

Code sample

import arcpy
arcpy.env.workspace = "C:/widgets"
rounded = arcpy.shape.RoundCorners("widgets", "rounded")
arcpy.shape.Bevel2(rounded, "bevelled", 4)
arcpy.shape.Bevel2("other", "other_bevelled")
